Domestic supply therefore not verified either way — null, not inferred.

Declared HS codes 300249 / 350790 / 392310 are only partly matched by observed trade: 35079062 (industrial enzymes) is confirmed on the import side; 300249 and 392310 do not appear in any visible record — HS should be corrected to the observed actuals (35079062, 21021090) rather than treated as a rejection ground. Domestic supply: no evidence found, not 'conditionally accepted'.
